messages:
Aisha R: Quick sync — QBR for Acme Inc. scheduled Mon 10am with execs. I'm finalizing slides and want to confirm: renewal risk tier, onboarding blockers, and top 3 enablement asks. I'll paste the slide outline below.

Tom G: Onboarding status: 2 teams live, 1 stalled on SSO (customer IT hasn't completed provisioning). Risk: Medium -> leaning High if not resolved this week.

Priya N: From AE: renewal health = Medium. Exec cares about uptime, time-to-first-value, and support responsiveness. Please add renewal timeline + $ at-risk.

Luca M: SE note — SSO uses Okta + SCIM; their IT has disabled SCIM provisioning. Proposed: hands-on troubleshooting session Wed 10am. I can run the session and capture logs.

Aisha R: Slide outline:
```
- Exec summary: Health = Medium (concise)
- Onboarding status: 2/3 prod, 1 blocked (SSO)
- Risk radar: impact vs probability
- Action items: SSO session, privacy/KMS review, success metrics
- Ask: Exec sign-off to allocate 2 weeks of engineering support
```

OpsBot: Deck link: https://bit.ly/acme-qbr-draft (edit access)

Tom G: I will confirm the IT contact and send the Wed invite. Also capturing feedback: privacy team asked for KMS integration notes (ticket JIRA-ACME-123).

Priya N: Exec bullets to add: 1) $120k ARR at risk; 2) proposed commitment: 2-week engineering burst; 3) mitigation timeline (2 weeks). I’ll add these to the deck.

Aisha R: Owner assignment: Luca -> SSO troubleshooting + session, Tom -> IT contact + privacy notes, Priya -> exec bullets + renewal ask, Aisha -> finalize deck + rehearsal Fri. React :thumbsup: if in agreement.

Luca M: :thumbsup:

Tom G: :thumbsup: added IT contact (sara@acme.com) and linked JIRA-ACME-123.

Aisha R: Thanks team — will ship the deck by Thu EOD and schedule a dry run for Fri 9am.
